plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to reduce leveraged ETF exposure to a small allocation.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad indices. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a reasonable growth outlook.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the single name concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL and SPAL, increasing leveraged ETF exposure within limits.
Increase SMH, pressing into the strong semiconductor sector.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It utilizes leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which significantly increases both upside and potential drawdown. Be aware of daily decay in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are hit.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes income-generating ETFs and broad indices, significantly reducing high-beta exposure.
